metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing vegetation cover near the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth between 1984 and 2021. This requires: 1. Location: Damietta branch of the Nile mouth in Egypt 2. Time periods: 1984 vs 2021 3. Vegetation indicator: NDVI is a good proxy for vegetation cover 4. Data sources: Need satellite imagery from both time periods For 1984, Landsat 5 would be appropriate (launched 1984). For 2021, Landsat 8 would work well. Strategy: - Define ROI around Damietta Nile mouth (Point + buffer) - Get Landsat 5 for 1984 and Landsat 8 for 2021 - Calculate NDVI for both time periods - Compute mean NDVI in the region - Compare values to determine if 1984 > 2021 Need to handle potential data gaps and validate results. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const damiettaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([31.492, 31.525]); // Damietta Nile mouth const roi = damiettaPoint.buffer(2000); // 2km buffer around the point const start1984 = '1984-01-01'; const end1984 = '1984-12-31'; const start2021 = '2021-01-01'; const end2021 = '2021-12-31'; // Function to calculate NDVI const addNDVI = function(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B4', 'B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); }; // 2. Data Acquisition for 1984 (Landsat 5) let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1984, end1984) .filterBounds(roi) .map(addNDVI); let col1984Size = col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${col1984Size}`); // Try fallback if no Landsat 5 data if (col1984Size === 0) { col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1984, end1984) .filterBounds(roi) .map(addNDVI); col1984Size = col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images (L4 fallback): ${col1984Size}`); } if (col1984Size === 0) { console.log("No data for 1984."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Data Acquisition for 2021 (Landsat 8) let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2021, end2021) .filterBounds(roi) .map(addNDVI); let col2021Size = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${col2021Size}`); if (col2021Size === 0) { console.log("No data for 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const composite1984 = col1984.median().select('NDVI'); const composite2021 = col2021.median().select('NDVI'); // 3. Check valid pixels const stats1984 = composite1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021 = composite2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1984 = stats1984.NDVI_count || 0; const count2021 = stats2021.NDVI_count || 0; const mean1984 = stats1984.NDVI_mean; const mean2021 = stats2021.NDVI_mean; console.log(`1984: NDVI=${mean1984?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count1984}`); console.log(`2021: NDVI=${mean2021?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2021}`); // 4. Validation checks if (count1984 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1984 === null || mean1984 === undefined || mean2021 === null || mean2021 === undefined || isNaN(mean1984) || isNaN(mean2021)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid NDVI values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final comparison if (mean1984 > 1 || mean1984 < -1 || mean2021 > 1 || mean2021 < -1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI range detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare vegetation cover (NDVI) if (mean1984 > mean2021) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
